scope: One bounded synthetic-only readout attribution gate; no encoder training or main-model change
optimizer: Adam .003, batch32, no clipping, fixed final update, 512 synthetic training rows
factor_control: Within each phi shape all arms have exactly the same weights, head, additive role offsets, parameter count, batches and random noise initially. Only fixed +/- Hadamard role projection or factor4 pooling scale differs. Full vs block has1396 vs1402 parameters; their phi initialization and capacity are only near-matched, not identical.
semantic_boundary: Fixed role IDs correspond to slot coordinates, not semantic supervision; paired value-ID permutation invariant, value-only permutation generally not invariant. All roles retained; no dynamic weighting or attention. This is a typed pooling control, not claimed globally novel.
data: Reuse previous XOR schedules for attribution, not independent confirmation. Each modality sees its own bit; G sees true shared S; fixed total Gaussian rate1 nat per modality, or pure-noise negative control.
primary_gate: For full phi, signed-minus-blind test NLL must be negative for all3 seeds and mean <=-.03 at BOTH mean and sum scales. This is an exploratory engineering gate, not significance or clinical superiority. Noise control absolute mean signed-minus-blind difference must be <.02 at both scales. No best-of-shapes selection.
secondary: Block-shape contrasts and role-by-scale interaction reported descriptively; role benefit restricted to shape or scale is conditional, not a robust main-model recommendation.
evaluation: Five exact paired stochastic draws, average per-draw censored-survival NLL, not averaged predictions or independent training. Fixed-head donor/zero/role-only permutations are sensitivity controls, not causal or MI proofs.
stability: Finite losses, maximum pre-update gradient L2, mean late gradient L2, and max absolute parameter value. No clipping or regularizer changes.
old_repeats: Six full/blind/mean executions must exactly match historical receipt NLL; they are deterministic repeats, not six new independent trainings.
outputs: Fresh ignored local_evidence output; publish aggregate receipt only
